verdict.rationale: Sierra provides explicit tone/brand-voice controls (Ghostwriter prompts for tone and style, Voice Personas tuned across 59 languages) plus testing/simulation tools to verify agent behavior across scenarios and avoid regressions, which supports consistency claims. However, all evidence is vendor-authored with no independent or hands-on verification that voice/tone actually stays consistent across topics and languages in production. Missing for 10: independent case studies or benchmarks confirming cross-topic/cross-language tone consistency, and detail on how brand-voice guardrails are enforced at scale.
